Done. The merge script ran once and succeeded.

- **Script:** `out/T4/solution.py` loads the three checkpoints, checks name sets and shapes, and verifies every non-MLP tensor is bit-identical across base, ft1 and ft2 before merging.
- **Merge:** each of the 64 MLP tensors is computed in float32 as base plus 0.4 times each task vector, both taken against the unmodified base, then cast back to float16. All other tensors are copied from the base unchanged.
- **Checks:** the script fails loudly on name or shared-tensor mismatch, on a merged count other than 64, and on an output count other than 244. It also re-reads the written file to confirm names, shapes, dtypes and bit-exact shared tensors.
- **Output:** `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors, and `out/T4/REPORT.md` with the self-report (one execution, no failures).
